svg.title: Austria wine-growing study atlas
svg.desc: Austria’s principal wine-growing concentration lies in the east, while the western Alps remain geographic context. Approximate study locations, not appellation boundaries. Numbers refer to the study key; a shared number connects places in one grouped lesson. 1: Wachau / Kamptal / Kremstal. Three distinct Lower Austrian areas west and northwest of Vienna; the grouped lesson does not merge their identities. 2: Wien (Vienna). Vineyards within and around the northern edge of Austria’s capital. 3: Weinviertel. Northeastern Lower Austria, north of Vienna. 4: Burgenland. Eastern Austria along the Hungarian border; the locator near Lake Neusiedl is not the whole region. 5: Steiermark (Styria). Southeastern Austria, south of Graz and near Slovenia.

g.text: Dots: representative places · outlines: geography, not appellation boundaries

text.tspan: Travel from the Danube vineyards to the
